youtube.baslik: In Türkiye, how many students in inclusion share one class? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Inclusive education means a student with special needs learning in the same class as peers, with the support needed. In Türkiye, the Guidance and Research Center, known as RAM, carries out the child's educational assessment and recommends the best setting; according to Ministry sources, students in inclusion are placed so that there are at most two in one class. A unit at the school prepares the individualized education program, called BEP in Türkiye; because the regulations are updated from time to time, details should be checked in the Ministry's current texts.
